contents.text: {"answer":"Yes. Recalls 24V868000 and 24V204000 cover certain 2022–2024 IONIQ 5 vehicles for ICCU damage that can stop battery charging and cause loss of drive power. That is a similar failure to the owner's reported ICCU failure, but the records do not establish that the underlying cause is identical.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2022-2024 IONIQ 5"},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2022-2024 IONIQ 5"},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-Volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power."},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11778792","quote":"ICCU failed without any notification."}]}
